_comment: USD per 1M tokens. Captured from provider catalogues on 2026-08-20; verify before
republishing, since these change. Raw token counts are kept in every result file so
any figure here can be recomputed without re-running the benchmark.
cacheRead is the discounted rate for a prompt-cache hit; cacheWrite is the premium
for establishing one (OpenAI-compatible providers do not bill a separate write).
openrouter/deepseek-v4.1-flash (added 2026-09-12) is served by ~13 backends at
0.15-0.375 in and 0.60-1.50 out, and OpenRouter picks one per request. The rate
here is DeepSeek's own endpoint - the cheapest, and 0.003 on a cache hit - so a
run must PIN that backend for this figure to be the one it paid:
can be routed to a backend up to 2.5x dearer and this under-states it.
